# Wray Ward

> > Full-service marketing communications agency specializing in home and building brands, with a commitment to community impact through nonprofit service grants.

Wray Ward is a Charlotte-based agency that partners with leading home and building product brands including VELUX, LEVOLOR, Mastic, Huber Engineered Woods, and Floor & Decor. The agency demonstrates social responsibility through EmpoWWer, a service grant program supporting local nonprofits like Hospitality House of Charlotte, Charlotte Family Housing, and Nourish Up.
